title: CAM Photosynthesis and Comparative C3, C4 and CAM Adaptations
word_count_method: Whitespace-separated words in saved p.teaching-prose; excludes questions, references, captions, tables, navigation and revision.

scope.official: 2026 revised CSIR–UGC–DBT Unit 6.A; separate CSIR Life Sciences Unit 6.A; MP SET 2024 mirrored syllabus Unit 6.A
scope.boundaries: Full photorespiratory cycle belongs to 6.B; detailed stomatal and hydraulic mechanisms belong to subsequent nodes.

Proton gradients, tonoplast transport, acidity and volume
ME and PEPCK routes, Calvin cycle, reserve regeneration

coverage_matrix.reasoning: Interpret acid pool and conductance curves

coverage_matrix.depth: Spatial and temporal separation, Rubisco competition and tradeoffs
Tracer, isotope, titration and gas exchange

review_pass_1.findings: Checked both CSIR syllabus versions and MP SET mirror, Winter 2019, CAM acid test, anatomy, CAM evolution and facultative transition reviews. Reviewed PEPC substrate, OAA reduction, vacuolar proton pumping, decarboxylation, C3/C4/CAM comparisons, four-phase variability and isotope limitations. Recomputed VPD ratios, 86.4 mmol flux, 0.08 mmol store, 50 µmol equivalents titration, isotope δ values, carbon atom and energy bookkeeping, retention and water-use examples. All question answers inspected; illustrative data marked.

review_pass_2.type: Separate internal editorial and static reader review
review_pass_2.findings: Reorganized foundational material into eight progressive theory sections with detailed subsections; compared depth to 6.A.07 QA (14,260 teaching words). Added revision terminology, comparative tables, 11 diagram zoom targets and balanced option keys. Verified no duplicate teaching paragraphs, missing section anchors, invalid ARIA references or answer mismatches; compiled inherited reader JS. Student-facing draft robots changed only for production.

quality.assessment: Internal rubric assessment, not external certification. Deductions for selected source verification rather than independent expert review, schematic figures not browser-tested, some distractors have concise rather than individual explanations, no interactive accessibility or runtime browser testing.

validation.reference_verification: Selected peer-reviewed academic references and official CSIR syllabus retrieved; MP SET mirrored PDF, not official host.

navigation.reciprocal: Dynamic reader navigation uses current homepage; unpublished target remains disabled.

limitations: No independent external academic review or exam calibration.
No browser rendering or screen-reader interaction test; static checks only.
MP SET syllabus mirror, not verified on official MPPSC host.
